name: jev_evaluate
description:
Evaluate one or many structured System One questions (`noul`, `choice`, `score`, `box`) in parallel over `state` via a single `POST /v1/systemone` call (~100-150ms). All questions execute simultaneously with zero extra latency (Speculative Fan-Out). Each entry in `questions` requires `type` and nonempty `instructions`:
- Noul (binary probability): `{"type": "noul", "instructions": "...", "criteria": {"true": "...", "false": "..."}}`
- Choice (1 of up to 255 options): `{"type": "choice", "instructions": "...", "criteria": {"opt_a": "...", "opt_b": "..."}}`
- Score (2-10 ordered rubric levels): `{"type": "score", "instructions": "...", "criteria": ["level 0 (lowest)", "level 1", "level 2 (highest)"]}`
- Box (bounding box on image asset, Jev 1.14+): `{"type": "box", "instructions": "the object in `photo`"}`. All question types support images. In assets, map unique references to {"path": "/absolute/photo.png"} (local file uploaded to TypeSafe) or {"format": "png", "data_base64": "..."}. Put each reference in a string in state, instructions, or criteria. PNG/JPEG, 280..1568 px per side, <=16 MiB. To inspect pixels, supply images in `assets`; a filename, path, or reference in `state` alone does not upload an image. Use `state={"photo":"img_1"}` with `assets={"img_1":{"path":"/absolute/photo.png"}}`, then ask about `photo`. The asset key `img_1` must occur in a string value of state, instructions, or criteria; object keys do not count. Attach every image needed for a comparison. A textual image summary is evidence about that summary, not unseen pixels. Every jev_evaluate question requires type and nonempty instructions; single-question tools infer type from their name and also require instructions. Define neutral criteria: describe alternatives or rubric levels, without asserting which answer is correct; put observations in state. If the evidence may be insufficient, include an unknown choice or ask a separate evidence-sufficiency question. A binary false result is not automatically proof of the opposite claim. A returned box does not establish object presence; box has no explicit absent-object output. Check presence with noul or choice including absent/unknown. You may batch presence and box, but discard the box when presence is absent or unresolved. Normalized coordinates and low-confidence regions alone are not successful localization.

name: jev_choice
description: Evaluate a single categorical `choice` question over `state`. Picks 1 of up to 255 named options defined in `criteria` (mapping option key -> description/criteria or null) and returns the winning `choice`, full `probabilities` distribution, and `confidence`. Use neutral option descriptions and include unknown when evidence may not distinguish the options. Check the final identifier against the supported decision. To inspect pixels, supply images in `assets`; a filename, path, or reference in `state` alone does not upload an image. Use `state={"photo":"img_1"}` with `assets={"img_1":{"path":"/absolute/photo.png"}}`, then ask about `photo`. The asset key `img_1` must occur in a string value of state, instructions, or criteria; object keys do not count. Attach every image needed for a comparison. A textual image summary is evidence about that summary, not unseen pixels.

name: jev_score
description: Evaluate a single ordinal `score` rubric question over `state`. `criteria` must be an ordered list of 2 to 10 rubric levels from lowest (index 0) to highest (index n-1). Returns the expected `score`, `normalized` value in [0.0, 1.0], `probabilities`, `legend`, and calibrated `confidence`. Define neutral ordered levels, not claims about the answer. To inspect pixels, supply images in `assets`; a filename, path, or reference in `state` alone does not upload an image. Use `state={"photo":"img_1"}` with `assets={"img_1":{"path":"/absolute/photo.png"}}`, then ask about `photo`. The asset key `img_1` must occur in a string value of state, instructions, or criteria; object keys do not count. Attach every image needed for a comparison. A textual image summary is evidence about that summary, not unseen pixels.

name: jev_noul
description: Evaluate a single binary `noul` (yes/no probability) question over `state`. Returns `noul` probability P(true) in [0.0, 1.0], boolean `verdict`, and derived `confidence` |2p - 1|. For supported/refuted/unknown, use choice or a separate evidence-sufficiency question; false need not establish the opposite claim. To inspect pixels, supply images in `assets`; a filename, path, or reference in `state` alone does not upload an image. Use `state={"photo":"img_1"}` with `assets={"img_1":{"path":"/absolute/photo.png"}}`, then ask about `photo`. The asset key `img_1` must occur in a string value of state, instructions, or criteria; object keys do not count. Attach every image needed for a comparison. A textual image summary is evidence about that summary, not unseen pixels.

name: jev_box
description: Evaluate a single `box` bounding-box detection question on an image asset using `jev-latest` (Jev 1.14+). Reference the asset key in `state` or `instructions` and pass `assets={"<ref>": {"path": "/absolute/photo.png"}}` to upload a local PNG/JPEG to TypeSafe, or use format and data_base64 for inline images. Returns normalized [0.0, 1.0] edges (`top`, `bottom`, `left`, `right`) and `confidence`. To inspect pixels, supply images in `assets`; a filename, path, or reference in `state` alone does not upload an image. Use `state={"photo":"img_1"}` with `assets={"img_1":{"path":"/absolute/photo.png"}}`, then ask about `photo`. The asset key `img_1` must occur in a string value of state, instructions, or criteria; object keys do not count. Attach every image needed for a comparison. A textual image summary is evidence about that summary, not unseen pixels. A returned box does not establish object presence; box has no explicit absent-object output. Check presence with noul or choice including absent/unknown. You may batch presence and box, but discard the box when presence is absent or unresolved. Normalized coordinates and low-confidence regions alone are not successful localization.

name: jev_status
description: Check TypeSafe API credential status (masked key and fingerprint only) and list available upstream Jev models (`jev-latest`, `jev-preview`, etc.) via `GET /v1/models`.
